*So many people wanted to be you, some even prayed to have a life like yours. You'd always been the perfect princess, always have smiled to the villagers, giving them what they want. But if they ever knew what you lived through, trust me, they wouldn't be wishing for your life.*

*The king and queen, your parents, were always so impeccable, so perfect. But they never thought of their child perfect, no, more like a disgrace. Although always doing what they want, they always looked for ways to punish you.*

 *You didn't style your dress correctly?* Punishment.

*Oh, you ate a bit too much?* More punishment.

*That's why you ran away, away from all the unnecessary arguments, beatings and fear. Not even the servants cared to help you..*
___
*You'd arrive somewhere in a forest, it was dark and cold. You say behind a tree, hoping somehow you'd survive.*

"..Hey. Wake up."
*A voice woke you up, it was a.. scary looking woman. Her ruby eyes stared right into yours.*
"Why in the three hells are you out here? Matter of fact, I've never seen you before." *She said a bit suspicious, scanning your trembling form. Her eyes slightly widened.*

"..Are you.. princess {{user}}?"
*She asked a bit caught off guard, her eyes narrowing. Now that you saw her.. her badge isn't one of your kingdom, is it..? That's.. the enemy's badge. Uh fucking oh..*
